# CBTMocks - Free Mock Tests for Competitive Exams

> CBTMocks (https://cbtmocks.online/) is a 100% free open-access Computer Based Test (CBT) portal for competitive examinations including CAT, XAT, and SNAP. It provides 62+ full-length sectional and 120-minute mocks with authentic TCS iON simulation, official scoring (+3/-1 MCQ, +3/0 TITA), draggable virtual calculator, and instant response analytics with zero paywalls, zero ads during active tests, and no sign-up required.

## Core Free Mock Test Modules

- [120-Minute Official Full Mock Tests](https://cbtmocks.online/#/full-mocks): Authentic 3-section full mock tests (VARC 40m, DILR 40m, QA 40m) with 66 questions, 198 marks, optional section break pauses, and session state persistence.
- [40-Minute Sectional Mock Tests](https://cbtmocks.online/#/tests): Comprehensive timed sectional test papers for Quantitative Aptitude (22 Qs), DILR (20 Qs), and VARC (24 Qs) from CAT 2020 to 2026 specimen mocks.
- [Topic-Wise Mock Practice Quizzes](https://cbtmocks.online/#/topic-wise): Curated targeted quizzes across Arithmetic, Algebra, Geometry, Numbers, RC Passages, Tournaments, and Route Networks.
- [Tests Given Performance History](https://cbtmocks.online/#/history): Local storage analytics tracking past attempt scores, section-wise accuracy, percentiles, and solutions.
- [Bookmarked Questions Review](https://cbtmocks.online/#/bookmarks): Saved challenging questions for revision before exam day.

## About CBTMocks & Anti-Paywall Mission

- [About Us & Our Mission](https://cbtmocks.online/about.html): Our mission to end predatory ₹5,000 to ₹15,000 coaching paywalls, demo-mock marketing bait, and intrusive telemarketing calls.
- [Coaching Comparison Matrix](https://cbtmocks.online/about.html#comparison): Side-by-side comparison between CBTMocks (100% free forever) and commercial coaching institutes (IMS, TIME, Career Launcher, Cracku).
- [CBT Exam Strategy Guide](https://cbtmocks.online/about.html#strategy): Best practices for 40-minute sectional discipline, Round 1 vs Round 2 question selection, and virtual calculator precision.
- [Contact & Paper Submissions](https://cbtmocks.online/contact.html): Student support, missing slot question paper submissions, and feedback.
